title: Unrestricted Static File Serving Exposes Environment Secrets and Database
cwe: CWE-552: Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties
root_cause: serve_static resolves requested paths against repository root without restricting file extensions or blocking dotfiles, .env files, .py source files, and database files.
remediation: Implement an explicit extension whitelist (.html, .css, .js, .png, .jpg, .svg, .woff2, .ico, .txt, .docx, .json) and deny any path starting with '.' or pointing into backend/, data/, .git/, or containing secret file patterns.

title: Hardcoded Plaintext Passwords and API Keys in Repository
root_cause: Default demo users in seed_demo_users contain hardcoded plaintext passwords, and .env files hold active API keys without a .gitignore file.
remediation: Store pre-computed password hashes or generate passwords from environment configuration, redact active keys from committed .env, provide .env.example, and enforce .gitignore.

title: API Key Exposure in HTTP Error Messages and Server Logs
cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
root_cause: When urllib.error.HTTPError is raised, the entire URL including '?key=GEMINI_API_KEY' is embedded into the RuntimeError exception message and logged to stdout.
remediation: Scrub sensitive query parameters (e.g., regex sub for [?&]key=[^&]+ with key=[REDACTED]) prior to formatting exception messages and logs.

title: System Prompt & Internal Architecture Disclosure via Client-Controlled Debug Parameter
cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
root_cause: print_prompt_debug checks req_body.get('debug'), which allows any end user to request that full internal prompts and system directives be collected and returned in the HTTP JSON response.
remediation: Do not let client request payloads enable prompt debugging. Restrict prompt debugging strictly to server-side environment flags, and strip debugPrompts from public API output.

title: Client-Controlled Plan Assignment and Privilege Escalation in Node Backend
root_cause: handleAuthSignup in server.js assigns body.plan directly if it is one of the valid plan names, permitting free registration directly into Diamond tier.
remediation: Enforce plan = 'free' on signup on all backend implementations regardless of client parameters.

title: Rate Limit Bypass via Untrusted X-Forwarded-For Header Spoofing
root_cause: client_ip blindly trusts the X-Forwarded-For header without verifying whether the direct socket client is an approved, trusted reverse proxy.
remediation: Only accept forwarded headers if direct socket IP matches TRUSTED_PROXIES configuration; otherwise default to direct client socket IP.

title: Missing Account Lockout on Consecutive Failed Login Attempts
cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts
root_cause: Login failures do not increment an account failure counter; after 5 failures an attacker can continue brute force across distributed IPs.
remediation: Track failed attempts per account/email, enforcing a 15-minute lockout after 5 consecutive failed logins per Security.txt specification.

title: Unquoted OAuth Token Parameter Injection in Google Tokeninfo
root_cause: The id_token parameter is directly formatted into the verification URL without urllib.parse.quote(), allowing query parameter injection.
remediation: URL-encode id_token using urllib.parse.quote(id_token, safe='') before query string concatenation.

title: Missing Secure & HttpOnly Cookie Directives for Session Management
cwe: CWE-614: Sensitive Cookie in HTTPS Session Without 'Secure' Attribute
root_cause: Authentication returns tokens strictly in JSON responses, requiring frontend localStorage storage and exposing tokens to XSS.
remediation: Emit Set-Cookie headers with HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/ on successful authentication.

title: Incomplete Security Headers and Missing Headers in Node Server
root_cause: Node backend sends zero defense headers; Python backend lacks Permissions-Policy, frame-ancestors, and object-src directives.
remediation: Unify standard defensive security headers across all backends: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), and comprehensive CSP.

title: Absence of Whitelisted Static File Types Allows Arbitrary File Traversal
cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory
root_cause: serve_static accepts any file under ROOT_DIR regardless of whether it is an executable script, configuration file, or database.
remediation: Restrict static asset delivery to explicit safe extensions (.html, .css, .js, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .svg, .ico, .woff2, .txt, .docx, .json) and block sensitive directories.

title: Missing Repository .gitignore Exposing Environment Secrets and Data
cwe: CWE-538: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Externally-Accessible File or Directory
root_cause: No .gitignore exists in NerdyBro, creating risk of accidental secret and database commits.
remediation: Add comprehensive .gitignore covering .env, *.sqlite3, node_modules, .next, __pycache__, and test caches.

title: Indirect Prompt Injection via Unbounded Reference Document Text in Quick Mode
root_cause: _build_quick_mode_prompt directly interpolates uploaded document content into the system/instruction prompt string without untrusted document XML encapsulation and strict hierarchy rules.
remediation: Encapsulate reference text inside <untrusted_reference_document> XML tags and prepend explicit instruction hierarchy rules forbidding document instructions from altering behavior.

title: Unbounded Memory Consumption in In-Memory Rate Limiter State
root_cause: The _rate_counters dictionary creates an entry for every distinct IP address seen and never prunes empty IP entries or caps maximum tracking entries.
remediation: Prune stale IP entries when empty or when total tracked IPs exceed a safe threshold (e.g., 5,000 entries).

title: Baseline Test Quota Expectation Mismatch Causing Suite Failure
cwe: CWE-698: Execution After Redirect (Code Quality / Inconsistent Invariant)
root_cause: test_prompt_debug.py fills 3 history entries expecting limit exhaustion, while PLAN_CONFIG['free']['weekly_limits']['Note Making'] is configured to 5.
remediation: Update test to dynamically populate history up to PLAN_CONFIG['free']['weekly_limits']['Note Making'] ensuring consistency.
